title: Pivot app to minimal “Iman limbu” landing page

requirements.summary: Set the browser tab/page title to exactly "Iman limbu".
acceptanceCriteria: In frontend/index.html, the <title> text is exactly "Iman limbu".
After loading the site, the browser tab title shows "Iman limbu".

file_operations.description: Replace the existing <title> value with exactly "Iman limbu" and ensure no runtime code overrides it.

requirements.summary: Replace the current UI with a single centered text element showing exactly "Iman limbu".
acceptanceCriteria: On first load, the page shows only one visible text element and it reads exactly: "Iman limbu".
There are no other visible UI elements such as login buttons, headers, footers, chat thread, settings, avatars, or descriptive paragraphs.
The displayed "Iman limbu" text is centered on the page (horizontally and vertically) and remains readable in both light and dark mode.

file_operations.description: Remove/stop rendering all existing app UI (auth, chat, settings, footer, background images) and render only a single centered text element whose content is exactly "Iman limbu". Use existing Tailwind/global theme tokens (e.g., bg-background/text-foreground) so it stays readable in light and dark mode, without modifying immutable hooks/providers or any files under frontend/src/components/ui.
